identity.name: Collectly
identity.aesthetic: Stripe-like Flat UI, High Contrast, Data-First

rules: Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for all Headings (h1-h6). Weight: 600 or 700.
Use 'Inter' for all body text, inputs, and table data. Weight: 400 or 500.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for financial figures, invoice numbers, and API keys.
Overlines/Labels must be Uppercase, text-xs, font-semibold, tracking-wider.

layout.structure: Sidebar Navigation (Left) + Top Header + Main Content Area

cards.header: px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-100 flex justify-between items-center

tables.header: bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-xs py-3 px-4 border-b border-slate-200

badges.style: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use 'shadow-sm' for cards. Avoid large drop shadows. Use 'shadow-none' for a flatter look if preferred.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 'border-slate-200' for subtle separation. 1px borders are preferred over shadows for depth.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly. Only for sticky headers: 'bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200'.
visual_enhancers.gradients: NO gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors. Subtle gradients allowed on primary buttons only.

assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all UI icons. Stroke width: 1.5px.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Flat UI' aesthetic: White cards, 1px slate-200 borders, minimal shadows.
Use the Sidebar Layout for all authenticated pages (Dashboard, Invoices, Settings).
Ensure all financial data (amounts, dates) uses 'JetBrains Mono' or 'Inter' with tabular-nums.
For the 'Integrations' page, use a grid of cards for Gmail and Stripe.
The 'Dashboard' must follow the 'Inverted Pyramid' rule: Key Metrics (Total AR, Overdue) at the top, followed by Activity Timeline and Recent Invoices.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts.
Create depth through z-index and subtle borders, not heavy shadows.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (p-6, p-8).
Prioritize Shadcn components but customize them to match the 'Flat UI' style defined here.
